This directory belongs to ST's **STSW-IMG054** package (`vl53l9-nucleo-n657-fmw-1.1.1`) and is

(Get Software → zip, e.g. `vl53l9-nucleo-n657-1.0.0.zip`)

Then, from the repository root:

```sh
scripts/import-st-package.sh ~/Downloads/vl53l9-nucleo-n657-1.0.0.zip
```
